meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 它会先运行 senpi --list-tips 并读你的 settings.json,再对照功能源码,用你的提问语言把某条 senpi 提示背后的实际机制讲清楚,同时说明你本人能看到哪些提示。
howto.when: 当你就某条 senpi 提示提问、想知道某个带提示的功能如何运作,或想了解自己能看到的提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会按你的语言讲这条提示的真实机制

say.text: 我这边能看到的提示有哪些?
say.note: 先查提示列表和你的设置再回答

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条提示是怎么回事?
say.note: 会讲完整的 fallback-architect 流程

howto.what_en: It runs senpi --list-tips and reads your settings.json first, then reads the feature's source to give a deep, verified explanation of a senpi tip in the language you asked in, plus which tips you personally can see.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Explains the tip's real mechanism in your language

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: Checks the tip list and your settings first

say_en.text: What's the tip after a Fable 5 refusal?
say_en.note: Walks through the whole fallback-architect flow
